Hi Jordan —

Hope you're well. Attached is invoice 2026-299 for the October usage period (PDF attached). To avoid any processing delays with your AP team I wanted to provide three remittance options and the docs we typically need for VAT reconciliation:

- Wire (preferred for US wire-outs): use the attached Wire_Instructions_Redwood.pdf. Beneficiary name: Redwood Inference, Inc.; Account ending: ••1284.
- ACH (domestic US): please confirm GL code and let us know the expected file date.
- Credit card: we can provide a secure payment link if AP prefers (3% fee applies).
